symbols.name: source length
symbols.meaning: The length of the source transform, which is the number of coordinates it acts on.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the length of the source transform, the number of coordinates it acts on.

symbols.name: target length
symbols.meaning: The length of the target transform, an integer greater than s coprime to s.
symbols.quote: Let $t>s$ be the target length, with $\gcd(s,t)=1$.

symbols.name: transform of length q
symbols.meaning: The discrete Fourier transform acting on vectors of length q.
symbols.quote: Here $F_q$ is the transform of length $q$.

symbols.name: source permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation on vectors of length s that sends u to the vector with entries u_{tj}, indices taken modulo s.
symbols.quote: Let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the coordinate permutations $(P_s u)_j=u_{tj}$ and $(P_t v)_k=v_{-sk}$, with indices taken modulo $s$ and $t$.

symbols.name: target permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation on vectors of length t that sends v to the vector with entries v_{-sk}, indices taken modulo t.
symbols.quote: Let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the coordinate permutations $(P_s u)_j=u_{tj}$ and $(P_t v)_k=v_{-sk}$, with indices taken modulo $s$ and $t$.

symbols.name: Gaussian width parameter
symbols.meaning: A fixed integer parameter that sets the width of the Gaussian weights in the resampling maps.
symbols.quote: Here $\alpha$ is a fixed integer parameter that sets the width of the Gaussian weights below.

symbols.name: forward resampling map
symbols.meaning: A contraction from vectors of length s to vectors of length t, used in the identity.
symbols.quote: The maps $A:\mathbb C^s\to\mathbb C^t$ and $B_0:\mathbb C^t\to\mathbb C^s$ are contractions, that is, linear maps that never increase the maximum-modulus norm of a vector.

symbols.name: backward resampling map
symbols.meaning: A contraction from vectors of length t back to vectors of length s, used in the identity.
symbols.quote: The maps $A:\mathbb C^s\to\mathbb C^t$ and $B_0:\mathbb C^t\to\mathbb C^s$ are contractions, that is, linear maps that never increase the maximum-modulus norm of a vector.

Thus Gaussian resampling expresses each source transform through a [Multidimensional transform with power-of-two axes](multidim-transform.md).
